title: South Main RV Park

explain.meaning: The site connects your RV to power, water and sewer.

services.name: Gathering Room Rental
services.desc: Groups are always welcome at South Main RV Park, regardless of whether you are staying as a guest at the park. Host your next small private event in our air-conditioned Gathering Room, consisting of a recreational room, dining and seating area, and kitchen. It’s ideal for: We offer a warm and welcoming setting, like walking into your own living room. Tables and seating for up to 25 people are provided with rental.
